scope: Read-only postprocessing of saved historical prescribed-teacher AB06 J1 nominal data and AB07 test1 data; only new diagnostic files in this audit directory.
conclusion: A measured-GRF discrepancy already existed in the historical AB06 IK-prescribed teacher: vertical impulse was 17.27% lower than measured, retained observed binary HS averaged 26.75 ms early, TO averaged 73.44 ms late. The AB07 prescribed test1 discrepancy is larger and its integrated-load error has the opposite sign. Subjects, start phases, duration and high-level control contracts differ, so the difference cannot be uniquely attributed to transfer of the frozen contact profiles or to the subject.

AB06_reference.source: Prescribed IK teacher via target_domain_imitation.prescribed_teacher_action, no learned policy as action source
AB06_reference.HS_count_note: 3 matched observed HS and no extra HS. One reference HS at reset13.94687098 s is unmatched; the reported bias describes the 3 subsequent matched onsets, not all4 reference events.
AB06_reference.TO_count_note: 3 matched TO of3 reference events, no extra TO.

method: The same pure read_storage/oracle_cycles functions and greedy one-to-one match_events function used by the AB07 analyzer. Vertical impulse uses saved post-step10ms boundaries and measured left verticalGRF interpolation on those same times. Events are saved binaryFSM events, not a detector re-run, actor counters or primary-force crossing substitutes.
protocol_limits: Subjects, reset phases and full duration differ (AB06 5s versus AB07 9.01s). The AB07 prefix has equal duration, not equal gait phase or identical control settings.

Both action sources derive from IK and both use left applied online GRF with measured GRF retained as reference. J1 normalized absolute teacher uses slew2.5/2 and exnovo-style FSM thresholds; AB07 test1 uses raw playback with disabled slew and imitation-style FSM thresholds.

The historical pinned YAML references the same three profile paths. Current profile hashes match AB07 captured inputs, but J1 receipt lacks individual historical profile hash attestation; this is provenance compatibility rather than a claim of bit-identical historical runtime.
The established binary-FSM onset channel is compared with offline measured-GRF cycle events. Onset, confirmation, delivery, actor acceptance and primary-force crossings remain distinct quantities.
Oracle GRF events use20N/50ms/300ms production extraction; startup partial events are excluded from nominal complete-cycle reference and unmatched observed events remain explicit.
All timing tolerances are inherited diagnostic references, not new AB06 or AB07 qualification gates.
The AB06 learned best47 control is deliberately excluded from this prescribed comparison.

provenance.initial_analysis_attempt: The first pure postprocessing attempt stopped before writing output because profile associations were looked up under source_files instead of profile_association. The corrected final analysis reads the captured profile_association. No runtime or input data were affected.
provenance.imports: Python standard library, numpy, PyYAML; only isolated pure AST-selected existing helper functions are executed.
